say:3:1322419002:0.text: What a surprise, Temesia! Do you have other things to take care of in Whiteridge?
say:3:1322419002:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅！你留在白山公国，是还有公务要处理吗？

say:4:1322419003:0.text: With the cultists still hanging around, Dame Temesia is staying to help guide the brainwashed villagers back to the righteous path, alongside the local acolytes.
say:4:1322419003:0.source_cn: 漏网的邪教徒还在附近作祟，所以特弥希娅大人会暂时留下，...

say:6:1322419007:1.text: Captain Rodrigo filled me in on the situation.
say:6:1322419007:1.source_cn: 白山诸多事宜，我已经从罗德里戈侍卫长这里听说了。

say:7:1322419008:1.text: Regarding Cyran... his involvement is suspicious, for sure, but we're dealing with a court mage here—a man with power, prestige, and deep political ties. The temple can't just launch an open investigation against him without cause.
say:7:1322419008:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷的所作所为的确很可疑，但他是帝国中一位很有威望...

say:8:1322419009:1.text: That's why I suggested Rodrigo issue a bounty instead. If we frame it as an internal matter for the Whiteridge Court, we might get some leads.
say:8:1322419009:1.source_cn: 所以我才建议罗德里戈先生贴了那份悬赏公告，希望能够从白...

say:9:1322419010:1.text: But for now, our biggest priority is rooting out the cult and restoring the villagers' faith.
say:9:1322419010:1.source_cn: 不过眼下最着急的还是铲除邪教徒，解决民众的信仰问题。

say:10:1322419011:1.text: If the cult's gotten bold enough to start kidnapping people, it means they've been operating in the shadows for a while...
say:10:1322419011:1.source_cn: 这里的邪教发展到了镇民失踪的程度，看来已经传播了不短的...

say:11:1322419012:1.text: And I failed to stop it. This is on me...

say:12:1322419013:1.text: No, this is a failure of the temple. When faith wavers, it's our duty to restore it. That's why I'm here.
say:12:1322419013:1.source_cn: 不，民众信仰动摇是教会的直接责任，我也是为此来到白山的。

say:25:1322419023:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你们两位使魔还是那么忠心和有趣。

say:26:1322419024:1.text: Thank you all. With you on our side, I'm sure Whiteridge will be back to normal soon.
say:26:1322419024:1.source_cn: 多谢你们。有你们的帮助，相信白山很快就会恢复往日的秩序。

say:28:1322419017:1.source_cn: 没错，我也在想是不是暗中调查为好。

say:29:1322419018:1.text: Good point. The missing person cases have made some people question the cult. This is the perfect chance to reach out to them.
